facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on CY-3211 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on CY-3211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on CY-3211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists. CY-3211 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 15 December 2025 an incident occurred on CY-3211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
